program: Home-delivered nutrition, wellbeing checks and senior transportation
priceScope: Conditional annual whole-recipient cost divided by a limited modeled local channel; not a verified marginal gift offer or complete portfolio EV

what: Meals on Wheels Montgomery County brings meals and friendly wellbeing checks to homebound older residents.
Its separate transportation program provides accessible rides to essential appointments and errands.
Congregate meals and other support help local seniors maintain nutrition and independence.
strengths: Eligibility prioritizes homebound people unable to prepare meals or rely on authorized caregivers.
The latest original return records annual meal recipients separately from meals and rides.
Regular delivery offers a practical nutrition and social-contact mechanism.
reservations: Client-reported improvements are not causal health or independence effects.
Homepage340,000 meals differs from original227,136 home-delivered meals and needs reconciliation.
Volunteer costs, program overlap and waitlist conversion limit claims about a marginal donation.

sections.what: Meals on Wheels Montgomery County brings meals and friendly wellbeing checks to homebound older residents. Its separate transportation program provides accessible rides to essential appointments and errands. Congregate meals and other support help local seniors maintain nutrition and independence.
sections.monitoring: Original FYendingSeptember2025 return records227,136 home-delivered meals to1,178 seniors,19,145 trips to493 people and781 congregate dinners atfour sites. Transport recipients may overlap meal recipients; they are not added. Currenthomepage340,000 meals and story21,000 rides differ from return classifications. Self-reports91percent improved emotional health and83percent mainmeal lack a controlled counterfactual. Request cohort entry/exit, actual service months, food-security change, healthcare use and net grocery spending.
sections.qualitative: Eligibility prioritizes homebound people unable to prepare meals or rely on authorized caregivers. The latest original return records annual meal recipients separately from meals and rides. Regular delivery offers a practical nutrition and social-contact mechanism. Client-reported improvements are not causal health or independence effects. Homepage340,000 meals differs from original227,136 home-delivered meals and needs reconciliation. Volunteer costs, program overlap and waitlist conversion limit claims about a marginal donation. Original return confirms Meals on Wheels Montgomery County, EIN23-7310650, Conroe, serving Montgomery County in the Houston metro. Official giving page links BetterUnite; no transaction performed. Eligibility is60plus, homebound, unabletodrive orpreparemeals, excluding people with a nonspouse caregiver or authorized meal provider.
sections.cost: The conditional annual partial-channel reference is $17.86 million per ten combined healthy-year welfare equivalents: 1.753991 clinical QALYs and 1.044375 signed resource equivalents. $10,000 corresponds to 0.005600 combined equivalents under proportional annual accounting, not demonstrated next-gift response. Full annual recognized recipient cost is $4,996,818. Annual observed1,178 meal clients treated as unique people, not227,136 meals or340,000 homepage meals. Additional annual response .3 versus family meals, authorized caregivers, grocery delivery and public nutrition alternatives gives353.4 exposed. Clinical response .4, utility .02 for .75finiteyear and full unionharm .001 are nutrition/check-in priors, not measured recipient clinical effects or mortality. Resource success .5 receives$600 genuinely avoided food orcare cash costs net of SNAP/public subsidies, family replacement, mealquality and alternative costs. Positive overlap .5 removes duplicated nutrition welfare before full$30 time/access burden, leaving$270 successful net and minus$30 otherwise. No retailmeal price, pet welfare or earnings of survivors is added. Oneadult consumptionbaseline$20,000, not household totals or gross salary. Union 353.4 household proxies contains clinical subgroup 141.35999999999999; no separate clinical population is added. One welfare-equivalent adult per household at $20,000 annual consumption, with components netted before one log. Positive components alone receive overlap adjustment; negative components, all unavoidable costs and union harms remain full. Clinical failure retains resource exposures and burdens. ResourceYears is fraction of one year’s gain, not repeated lifetime payments. No retail medicines, gross salaries, ordinary survivor earnings or property wealth are counted. External volunteer time and subsidized provider/public expenditure unknown centrally; largerfullcost and distinctpayer-loss cases examine this. Other transportation, congregate, petfood and caregiver benefits unknown and omitted, not declaredzero. Financial-only and negativeburden scenarios retained. Central partner/payer zero is unknown-neutral, not observed zero or complete world net benefit. Other programs and external opportunity costs remain unknown; whole recipient cost versus this narrow channel is not complete portfolio EV or a marginal gift offer.

model.costScope: Whole annual recognized recipient cost versus conditional meal nutrition/check-in and netcash channel; otherprograms and externalcost unknown
model.geographicAttribution: Montgomery County inHouston metro; full1.0 localshare once
model.formula: Union=N*unique*b; clinical=union*completion*q*discounted finite years minus full union harms. Financial=.5*people*discounted one-year log(1+joint net gain/baseline), local share once. Headline=10*C/(clinical+financial).
model.counterfactual: Family/caregiver meals, SNAP/publicnutrition, grocerydelivery and paidmeal alternatives retained
model.attribution: Annual incremental recipient response is distinct from cohort deduplication and geographic share; no claim of whole annual portfolio or marginal donation causal effect.
model.uncertainty: Source-grounded original cost/services; all causal mapping, utility and net resource priors unsupported. Complete portfolio and marginal donor EV unknown.
model.nativeOutcomes: Unique oldermeal recipients, finite nutritional/connection utility and actual cashcosts avoided; notmeals,retailvalue or self-reportedcausality
